mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, si.title AS showTitle, ss.session_name AS sessionName, ss.session_time AS sessionTime, o.amount AS amount, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, o.status AS status, o.expire_time AS expireTime, o.pay_time AS payTime FROM orders o LEFT JOIN show_info si ON si.id = o.show_id LEFT JOIN show_session ss ON ss.id = o.session_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId}
